newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Korea Ind mulls Midopa takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Korea Ind mulls Midopa takeover bid.

text.p: Korea Industrial Co is considering launching a hostile takeover of Midopa Department Store Co, a company statement said on Thursday.
The statement said the company would announce its decision on the takeover within a month.
Hours before Korea Industrial's announcement, Shindongbang Corp also told the Korea Stock Exchange it was mulling a takeover bid of Midopa.
The president of Korea Industrial is a younger brother of president of Shindongbang.
Traders speculated that Korea Industrial planned to help Shindongbang advance into the distribution business by acquiring Midopa.
A Shindongbang spokesman denied the rumours.
"The two companies are totally different enterprises and they have not negotiated any such deals," he said. "As we announced today, we will soon decide whether to buy a stake in Midopa or not."
Brokers said Midopa's stock price had risen for a month on takeover rumours. The stock ended Thursday's trading at its lower limit of 41,500 won, down 3,600.
